# CG-REQ-021: Request enum value added

A request value accepts more enumerated values (or the enum was removed).

**Why it matters:** Additional values widen accepted requests.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Direction | request |
| Detects | `schema.enumChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> {where} now also accepts {values}.
>
> Existing consumers are unaffected.
>
> **Fix:** No action needed.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: value added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, enum: [a, b]}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, enum: [a, b, c]}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. POST /x: the request body (application/json) now also accepts c.

### Fires: enum removed entirely

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, enum: [a, b]}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. POST /x: the request body (application/json) now also accepts any value.

### Does not fire: response direction

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, enum: [a, b]}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, enum: [a, b, c]}}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml
rules:
  ignore:
    - rule: CG-REQ-021
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:
    CG-REQ-021: { severity: low }
```
